system.effect:
Trigger - Your Dark-Type Pokémon uses a Move with the Social keyword.
Effect: Your Pokémon may immediately use a naturally Dark-Typed Status-Class Move or a Move with the Social keyword as a Free Action. This must be a different Move than the triggering Move, and must follow all Frequency limitations. Devious may be used only once per Scene per Pokémon. While a New Moon Weather Condition is present, this Feature's Frequency becomes "EOT", and the Move used through the Feature may be used ignoring Frequency.
system.name: Devious

ptu.prereqBackup: Clever Ruse, Type-Linked Skill at Expert
